description: Raises stream temperature to a specified outlet temperature.
notes: CalcMode is set to OutletTemperature automatically. T_out must be above the bubble point of the feed to produce any vapour in a downstream Vessel.

description: Reduces stream temperature to a specified outlet temperature.
notes: T_out must be below the feed temperature. For flash separation downstream, T_out must be above the bubble point.

description: Flash separator producing vapour (port 0) and liquid (port 1).
notes: Requires VLE-capable property package. Feed must be in the two-phase region (T between bubble and dew point). NRTL/UNIQUAC require BIPs or outlet will equal feed.

description: Combines multiple inlet streams into one outlet.
notes: All inlets must contain the same set of compounds. Auto-inserted by normaliser when a unit receives >1 inlet.

description: Splits total flow by fixed ratio. Does not perform phase separation.

required_params.name: split_fractions
required_params.description: Dict {stream_tag: fraction}. Fractions must sum to 1.0.

notes: Auto-inserted by normaliser when a unit has >1 outlet. Equal split assumed by default.
Liquid-only. P_out must be greater than inlet pressure.
Gas-phase only. Use Peng-Robinson or SRK for best results.

description: Reduces gas/vapour stream pressure, producing work.
notes: Gas-phase expansion. P_out must be less than inlet pressure.
